༄༅/ /'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed dpa' bo 'bru gcig pa'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed dpa' bo 'bru gcig pa'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so//

ya mān+ta ka la na mo/ 'jam dpal gyi cho ga zhib mo khro bo thams cad rnam par rgyal ba'i cho ga zhib mo bsdus pa zhes bya ba/ dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi rgyud las 'phags pa 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi cho ga zhib mo phyi ma'i phyi ma rim par phye ba bcu gcig pa las/ de nas cho ga thams cad kyi// phyi ma'i phyi ma zhes bya ba// sbyor bar bcas shing rgyas pa yi| |cho ga dag ni bshad par bya// zhes pa nas cho ga thams cad bsdus pa'o// zhes pa'i bar dang*/ yang rgyud de nyid kyi rim par phye ba bcu gcig par/ sngags kyi cho ga rim bzhin bya// zhes pa nas| dngos grub mchog ni thob par 'gyur// zhes pa'i bar gyi don rnams bsdus pa/ 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed dpa' bo 'bru gcig pa'i sgrub thabs khrigs chags su bya ba ni/ brag phug sogs gnas dben par ras gtsang mar tshon rtsi dri bzang dang bcas pas mngon rtogs ltar lha'i snang brnyan bris pa bkram pa'i mdun du/ sman raka gtor ma mchod pa rnams bsham/ rang nyid stan bde bar bris sku zhal byang du phyogs pa'i mdun du rang nyid lhor phyogs nas bsam gtan gyi yan lag dang smyung bar gnas pas 'khod/ cha gsum gtor ma btang*/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa byas la/ bdud rtsi'i ril bus kha dag par byas te/ las gshin gyi sngags kyis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ gzung 'dzin gyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad 'od gsal stong pa nyid kyi ngang las/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la ma he nag po khros pa/ rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i steng du rang gi rig pa'i hūm̐ yig nag po 'od 'bar ba/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid skad cig gis rdzogs pa sgyu ma lta bu'i bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed sku mdog nag po char sprin lta bur zhal bsgrad cing 'jigs pa'i gzugs can/ smin ma dang sma ra ag tshom ba spu thams cad me ltar 'bar zhing ser ba/

thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu rtsa gcig gi se ral khar 'phyang ba/ spyan gsum 'khrugs shing dbu skra dmar ser gyen la brdzes pa/ mche ba bzhi gtsigs shing 'khrugs shing 'jigs pa'i sgra 'byin pa/ mdangs gsal zhing sgeg pa/ g.yas be con 'phyar zhing g.yon sdigs mdzub bsgrengs pa/ ma he'i gdan la g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang bas 'gyings pa/ yan lag thams cad sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag lpags kyi smad dkris/ 'jig dus kyi me 'bar zhing 'khrugs pa'i klong na bzhugs pa'i thugs kar 'bar zhing g.yo ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i dbus su hūm̐ nag po 'od zer 'bum phrag g.yo ba dang sdud pa'i 'od kyis bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa oṃ hūm̐ hrīḥṣ+ṭī ā gats+tsha yaṃ phraṃ thā na swā hā/ gnyis su med par gyur/ oṃ hūm̐ hrīḥka laṃ thā na hā/ zhes mchod yon dang*/ oṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ka ra la ra na ha hā/ zhes me tog dang*/ oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hūm̐ pa shi kha hā/ zhes bdug pa dang*/ oṃ dz+raṃ dz+rīṃ hā/ zhes mar me dang*/ oṃ hūm̐ hrīḥṣ+ṭī khuṃ kha/ zhes dri chab dang*/ oṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ kha ka kha/ zhes sman raka gtor ma rnams dbul/ sngags bzla ba ni/ sa bon las 'od phreng 'bar zhing spro ba sems gtad nas bzla ba ste/ 'bru gcig pa zhes sngags kyang hūm̐ kho na yin yang*/ rgyud 'di ni rim par phye ba bcu par/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi khro bo gang*// ming ni gshin rje'i gshed ces bya// de yi snying po mchog de ni/ hūm̐ zhes bya ba'i yi ge gcig /thog mar oṃ bzhag cho ga bzhin// zhes dang*/ rim par phye ba bcu gcig par/ oṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ khro bo'i snying po'o/ zhes mthar/ swā hā yang 'dogs par gsungs so/ de dag gi grangs tshad ni rim par phye ba bcu par/ ri mo'i spyan sngar 'dug nas ni// 'di ni 'bum phrag bcu bzlas nas// de nas 'og tu bsgrub la 'jug

/ces dang*/ rim par phye ba bcu gsum pa/ de yi 'og tu bsnyen pa ni/ bye ba gcig tu nges par bshad// khro bo'i brtul zhugs zhes bcad nas// dngos grub mchog ni thob par 'gyur// zhes bye ba gcig dang*/ rtags kyi bsnyen pa ni/ rim par phye ba bcu par/ ri rab steng na ji tsam du// g.yo bar 'gyur gyi bar du bzla// yang na khro bo gshin rje'i gshed// bzhad dam g.yo ba'i bar du bzla// yang na rab kyis 'bar gyi bar// bzlas na de tshe dngos grub thob// ces pa ltar/ rtags ma mthong gi bar du bzla'o// thun mtshams rnams su gong gi sngags rnams kyis mchod/ mthar bsdu ba'i tshe/ oṃ hūm̐ hrīḥṣ+ṭī ā gats+tsha hūm̐ su na ra ga ma na ya swā hā/ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa 'od du zhu ba hūm̐ la bsdu/ de'ang 'od gsal stong pa nyid du 'jug par bya'o// de'i mthar/ dge ba 'di yis sems can rnams// bde bar gshegs ldan dge bar 'gyur// bde ba thams cad yongs rdzogs shing*// dge ba kun gyi snod gyur cig /ces dge rtsa bsngo'o/ de ltar 'bad pa'i phan yon ni// rim par phye ba de nyid du// de ltar lha ni bzlas pa yi// dngos grub ya mtshan de yin no// de nas rig 'dzin dpal dang ldan// grub par 'dod rnams kun 'grub pa// ci bsam pa ni de dag kun// ring por mi thogs 'byor par 'gyur// khros na sa yang 'gas par 'gyur// chu dag kyang ni bskam par 'gyur// ri rnams thams cad bsnyil bar nus// rgya mtsho dag kyang skem par byed// de la sogs pa'i las rnams ni// ya mtshan chen po thams cad dang*// sems can rnam pa sna tshogs par// phan pa rnam pa sna tshogs byed// cho ga snga ma bzhin du bsgrub// bsgrubs nas sems can thams cad la// 'bras bu mchog rnams 'grub par byed// grub pa'i mthu ni gang yod pa// bde gshegs bsam na de dag kun// 'jungs pa med pa'i bsam pa yis// skye bo phongs pa rnams la sbyin// snying rje can gyis bdag gi lus// phongs pa dag la rtag tu sbyin// de ltar sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin// dri ma med par bsgrub par bya// gang zhig de ltar sngags sgrub pa// dri ma med pa byang chub sems// bde ba rtag tu spyod pa ste| |dngos grub rtogs las gang gsungs pa// de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhabs las byung*// thams cad de la nyer bar gnas// sgrub pa po de rdzu 'phrul gyi// yon tan kun dang ldan par 'gyur// de ltar 'jam dpal khro bo yi// zhal nas gsungs pa'i go cha ni// khro bo rnam rgyal rgya cher bstan// cho ga thams cad bsdus pa'o// zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs so// smras pa/

blo gros gshog yang dkar po yis// rgyud don pha mtha' kun bcad de// nyer mkho rnams mang blor tshud nas// rang bzo'i tshogs la smon ma dgos// de ltar 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed dpa' bo 'bru gcig pa'i sgrub thabs 'di'ang*/ gong du smos pa'i rgyud de rnams nyid rmi lam du bstar nas don thams cad legs par bsdus pa ste/ 'di'ang 'bri gung pa chos kyi grags pas/ me byi smin drug zla ba'i tshes lnga la bye ri stag rtse'i kun gsal gsang sngags pho brang du bsdus shing bris pa dag go// //sarba maṅga laṃ//
